supporting_observations.claim: WINWORD.EXE opened Downloads\Statement.docm, then launched PowerShell as its child. The PowerShell command used -nop, -w hidden, and -enc; its decoded command downloads and executes a script from raw.githubusercontent.com.
PowerShell retrieved the matching u.ps1 URL from raw.githubusercontent.com through the proxy; the inspected request returned status 200.

PowerShell then started rundll32 with C:\Users\maria.lopez\AppData\Roaming\svchelper.dll,Init. This sequence is strongly suspicious, although the records do not verify that the DLL loaded successfully.
A network logon for maria.lopez to WS-MLOPEZ-01 came from WS-LPARK-01 shortly after the PowerShell activity. The record shows LogonType 3, not an interactive logon.
